# Keep multiple recoverable drafts from replacing each other

## What & Why
If a user dismisses a second unsaved answer or opportunity before recovering the first, the current single-notice state can replace the earlier draft. Preserving each recoverable draft avoids silently losing work.

## Done looks like
- Dismissing another draft does not silently remove an earlier still-valid recovery option.
- Users can identify and recover each available draft independently.
- Browser coverage verifies the behavior for both answer and opportunity drafts.
